newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak bourse extends losses, SAX down 1.23 pts.
newsitem.headline: Slovak bourse extends losses, SAX down 1.23 pts.

text.p: Slovakia's Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) closed the week in listless trading on Friday, with shallow losses to most of the blue chips pulling the 16-share SAX index down 1.23 points to 166.22.

Brokers said the current decline, caused by a lack of investors' interest due to concerns about the economic and political situation in the country, would likely continue over a traditionally quiet summer season.
Steel maker VSZ closed down one crown at 629, on a volume of 111 shares. Oil refinery Slovnaft lost one crown to 809 on nine traded shares. Only 163 shares were traded on the BSE's main floor.
Oil and gas storage firm Nafta NAFT.BV, which did not trade over the week, lost 71 crowns on Friday, closing at 1,200 on 26 traded shares.

Overall, volume increased to 823,583 shares from 473,065 shares traded on Thursday, while turnover eased to 266.33 million crowns from 294.64 million. Both the volume and turnover were boosted by direct trades. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402
